name: Mega Fortris Berhad
overview: 2026年，公司与V.S. International Group Limited终止了2024年签订的谅解备忘录，未产生法律义务或重大财务影响。此外，以进行经常性关联交易。其他公告主要涉及诉讼、委员会变动及股东大会等事项。
overview_en: In 2026, the company terminated the Memorandum of Understanding with V.S. International Group Limited signed in 2024, with no legal obligation or material financial impact. Additionally, the company proposed to renew the existing shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions. Other announcements mainly involved litigation, committee changes, and general meetings.

segments.name: 集团 / Group
segments.note: 公司终止了与V.S. International Group Limited的谅解备忘录。
segments.note_en: The company terminated the MOU with V.S. International Group Limited and proposed to renew the shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions.

actions.title: MEGA FORTRIS BERHAD ("Mega Fortris" or "the Company") - PROPOSED RENEWAL OF EXISTING SHAREHOLDERS' MANDATE FOR RECURRENT RELATED PARTY TRANS
actions.text: 以进行具有收入或交易性质的经常性关联交易。
actions.text_en: The company proposed to renew the existing shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions of a revenue or trading nature.

actions.title: MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING
actions.text: 公司与V.S. International Group Limited于2026年1月6日双方同意终止2024年1月18日签订的谅解备忘录，终止后双方互不索赔，且不会对公司产生法律义务或重大财务影响。
actions.text_en: The company and V.S. International Group Limited mutually agreed on 6 January 2026 to terminate the MOU signed on 18 January 2024;
